semiconductor_relevance: High — Asahi Kiki specializes in Fan Filter Units (FFUs) essential for maintaining cleanroom environments in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Asahi Kiki, through its brand TOPWELL, manufactures Fan Filter Units (FFUs) that are crucial for clean air supply in semiconductor fabs. Their products are recognized for high efficiency and performance, and they offer upgrade services for existing FFUs, enhancing operational effectiveness in cleanroom settings.

regional_presence.Taiwan: The company is based in Taiwan and serves semiconductor factories globally.
